unverified_summary: Freetins did not redeem any listed code. The official Pokémon Horizons announcement establishes the 8:00 p.m. local research deadline, while Leek Duck supplies the exact reward quantities. Leek Duck also reports FENDI code acceptance beyond the official January 4, 2025 end date; no Freetins claim resolves that discrepancy. The LEGO research completion deadline should not be reused as an exact redemption cutoff for every LEGO code.

next_change.pattern: Publisher announcements can change rewards and requirements. No fixed code-release schedule is established.
